diagnostics.method: Every actual routing endpoint: native cumulative volume balance and independently integrated live signed boundary flows against all node+link storage. Exact parent input bytes; same engine, no physical validation.
diagnostics.native_error_limit_note: The pinned engine can report tiny percent error for a finite bench-scale residual; explicit native totals and live storage are checked instead.
diagnostics.tolerance_budget: Initial live storage plus independently integrated gross external inflow and gross receiving backflow; shared by both residual checks. Native net outflow is retained separately.
